title: Unique Flaky Peruvian Potatoes Picarones
description: A fresh and light Peruvian dish featuring floury potatoes, formed into picarones and fried until crispy, this keto-friendly recipe is perfect for a snack or dessert. The combination of potatoes, rice flour, and khao khuas gives it a unique flavor and texture.
instructions: Boil the diced potatoes in water until they are tender, then drain and let them cool.
Grind the cooled potatoes into a fine mash using a fork or potato masher.
In a large bowl, combine the mashed potatoes, rice flour, khao khuas, eggs, and salt, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape using a rolling pin or your hands.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat until it reaches 350 degrees.
Fry the picarones in batches until they are golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain the fried picarones on paper towels and serve warm.
